> Teaching story. Living project architecture for humans and review grounding. Not Typology seed evidence (see `evidence/typology/architecture_brief.md`).
The `gitboard` architecture organizes functionality into discrete operational slices, separating long-running background processes from external interface capabilities.
### Operational Slices
The system is composed of specialized slices defined by their objective ledger entries:
Jobs: These slices handle asynchronous, discrete units of work, managing the lifecycle of background tasks and data processing within the repository.
Server: The package provides HTTP surface capabilities and mux wiring, acting as the primary entrypoint for external interaction.
### Doors and Entrypoints
Access to the system is governed by distinct "doors":
The Server Door: Provides the HTTP interface, routing incoming requests to the appropriate internal logic.
The Job Entrypoint: Orchestrates the execution of background tasks, ensuring work is processed according to the system's state.
